title: Share workspace evidence across Linux IFX checks
goal: Run one immutable workspace scan, reuse its locked facts in expensive modules, and complete one 300-second Linux timing run without changing rule semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: The evidence producer performs one bounded link-safe enumeration and records canonical paths, raw and normalized hashes, and cached text.
Consumers verify the evidence file hash and target commit before using it.
The five highest-risk traversal/hash modules retain findings, coverage, and zero-subject behavior with a direct-scan fallback.
G03 reconciliation and snapshot checks do not repeat an immutable source projection.
Focused clean and negative fixtures pass before a single complete Linux timing run.
All Linux diagnostic module watchdogs remain 300 seconds and every module duration is recorded.
